Edition — Your Personalized Daily Newspaper | Edition

# P R I N T I S B A C K.

Your morning newspaper. Designed for print. Created for you.

### Pick your topics.

Choose the subjects you care about. Your Edition is built around your interests, not an algorithm's.

### Printed while you sleep.

Sourced, written, designed, and delivered. All before your alarm goes off.

### Put the phone down.

Print it and read with coffee. Or open it on any screen. Either way, it has a last page. You read it, you finish it, you start your day.

## The morning scroll wasn't designed to end. Edition was.

A real newspaper, personalized to your interests and delivered each morning. No feeds. No endless scroll. Just the stories that matter, designed for the kitchen table, not the lock screen. A front page, a last page, and your name on both.
